Hey team, catching up on this thread. I've created a < to track the default value behavior for custom fields. We'll investigate if this is desired behavior outside of the WF context and how difficult it might be to let the user choose the overwrite behavior. On the point regarding CFs being freeform text, that is a bigger data modeling issue that we will want to solve for the medium to long term after fixing any immediate escalations and issues. Custom fields are essentially a key value store attached to each interest where the key and the value adhere to no schema, other than being strings. I suspect the flexible nature of it is the reason that we decided to throw all these waterfall parameters in them. However, it's this exact flexible nature that makes them not a good fit and we're seeing the failure modes now. We can invest in patching this problem and keep referencing waterfall parameters in custom fields (e.g. case insensitive matching, typed enum/dropdown) for the short term. But looking to the medium to longer term, we should back these waterfall parameters with a typed, validated table rather than tracking them in CFs.
